name: Malicious Package Quarantine
description: When a malicious package is detected, quarantine it, block installation, and alert consumers.
purpose: Prevent malicious packages from being installed or used in any build by implementing automated quarantine, installation blocking, and consumer notification.
acceptanceCriteria: Quarantine mechanism detects known malicious packages by hash, name, or version pattern.
Quarantined packages are blocked from installation in all environments (dev, CI, production).
Alert is sent to designated security and engineering channels when a quarantine event occurs.
Quarantine list is version-controlled and updatable without a full release.
Existing installs of quarantined packages are flagged in the next scan.
Quarantine can be bypassed only with explicit, audited override.
Quarantine events are logged with package details, detection method, and timestamp.
